subject: GCP private offer: procurement MAP & billing gates (Acme Cloud)
messages:
From: Jamie Chen <jamie.chen@acmecloud.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: 2029-07-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: MAP + billing path for GCP private offer

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement at Acme is ready to move toward a private offer on GCP, but they need a mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out evaluation milestones, procurement checkpoints, and the billing path. Primary asks from our side:
- Draft MAP with dates for eval -> PO -> marketplace activation
- Billing flow: who signs invoices, expected remittance details, and whether monthly invoicing is supported
- Vendor paperwork: W-9, insurance cert, and standard P2P metadata for our AP system

I've attached our PO template for reference. Can you send a MAP and a short checklist for procurement? We want to aim for invoice-ready PO by the end of July but will need to confirm internal approvers first.

Thanks,
Jamie Chen
Sourcing Manager, Acme Cloud
Attachment: Acme_PO_Template.docx (DOCX)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Chen <jamie.chen@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-07-11T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + billing path for GCP private offer

Jamie — thanks for the clear ask. Putting a MAP stub together now and attaching version 1. High level plan below (proposed dates):

- Week 1 (Jul 12-19): Technical acceptance/eval (shared perf baselines, final gating prompts)
- Week 2 (Jul 22-26): Procurement review (PO template, legal redlines)
- Week 3 (Jul 29-Aug 2): Final PO sign and marketplace private-offer activation

Billing and invoicing notes:
- We can invoice monthly. For GCP private offers we typically set billing to flow through the marketplace with Redwood listed as the vendor of record, then provide monthly invoices to your finance contact.
- Need to confirm remittance address and whether Acme requires net-30 or net-45 terms in the PO.

Attachments in this message: MAP_ACME_GCP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft, milestones + owners).

Could you confirm the procurement approvers and whether Acme requires vendor onboarding (W-9 + insurance) up front or post-PO? Also looping Karthik and Jordan to help on legal/marketplace setup.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_ACME_GCP_v1.xlsx (XLSX)

Logan — got the MAP, thanks. A few clarifications from procurement:
- Approvers: CFO (Maya Ortiz) and Head of Cloud Ops (Raj Patel). Both will need a short summary of commercial and security posture.
- Vendor onboarding: Acme requires W-9 and insurance cert BEFORE PO issuance for new vendors. Can you provide those?

We'll aim to complete internal approvals by Jul 22 if we receive the vendor docs this week.
